one_line_contribution: A pre-registered ALFWorld measurement of how much of a retrieved procedural-memory bank's value is already held by a GEPA-optimized instruction written from the *same* training episodes, identified by crossing instruction provenance with bank provenance across two task-type sets (the 'square') and reported as two numbers with intervals: an absorbed share A of the bank's task-type-specific advantage, and a TOST equivalence test on the bank's residual gain g(I_own, B_own) at the optimized instruction.
closest_prior_work: ExpeL (arXiv 2308.10144), and the proposal concedes it correctly in Related Work (0) and Risk 31. ExpeL's published ablation removes the prepended distilled-insight block and the retrieved-trajectory block *separately*, both built from one training pool, and reports each single-container condition against the full system in ALFWorld. That is exactly this proposal's two-container redundancy measurement, in exactly this environment, since 2023. What survives is narrow and correctly stated: ExpeL's two containers draw on one undifferentiated pool, so it measures redundancy between two representations of a corpus rather than absorption of specific episodes; it is unpaired, not token-matched, single-run, and its instruction container is a fixed extraction routine rather than a search-based reflective optimizer. The problem is that the size of that residual gap is unknown even to the authors, who state plainly that arXiv is unreachable from their node and that they have never read ExpeL's ablation table. A contribution whose entire margin over a 2023 paper is a table nobody in the loop has opened is not a novelty claim, it is a hypothesis about a novelty claim. Secondary threats the proposal also concedes: EvoAgentBench (2607.05202) already publishes the qualitative headline (ReasoningBank +3.6 vs GEPA +1.2 on the same 528/267 trajectories); MIPROv2 (2406.11695) established the instruction-vs-demonstration two-container ablation; AutoManual (2405.16247) and AutoGuide (2403.08978) already rewrite ALFWorld episodic experience as instruction text and show a compiled manual competing with retrieval, which retires the compile-once arm (row 11 / prediction 6) as replication.
strongest_objection: The design cannot reach its own headline, and the fallback it will actually reach is selected by the one statistic in the document that has no standard error. Two chained problems. (1) Survival arithmetic: the paper's title T1 requires clearing G0, G1 (>=5pt with LB>=2pt under *both* I0 variants), G2 (>=3pt on both seeds and both type sets with a local 32B reflector, which the authors themselves flag as at real risk against arXiv 2604.14585), G3 (>=9pt, which Risk 1 calls 'deliberately a coin flip'), G3b, G4 bracketing, G5 throughput and G6, and *then* a triple conjunction whose weakest link is endpoint E, the +/-3pt TOST on g(I_own, B_own), which by the proposal's own SE(g) = 1.41pt is declarable only when |g-hat| <= 0.68pt. Risk 34 concedes that a realistic absorption effect (share 0.6, 2pt residual) routes to T2, not T1. Multiplying honest per-gate pass rates against 50-80% power on A and a co-primary A0 the authors say is harder still, the modal output of ~990,000 model calls and 84 GPU-hours is one of the seven pre-registered fallback papers, most of which are descriptive ('the type-generic finding', 'the optimizer-failure paper', 'the residual-gain paper with bounded-loss CIs'). (2) Which fallback fires is decided by Rule M's 2/3 help/off bucket, which is a *column of the truth table*: with the shares passing and E passing, help-dominant gives row 1 and title T1 ('Full absorption'), off-dominant gives row 3 and title T4 ('no absorption claim'). Measurement and Noise Control gives standard errors for A, A0, A_all, g, R, A_epi, the inflation difference and every equivalence margin, but gives none for the help/off decomposition. It cannot: help(I) and off(I) are each paired differences with SE about 1.4pt, so the 2/3 share of a Delta-Inner that the design plans at roughly 4-6pt is not estimable at n = 1,200. The paper's headline claim and its exact negation are therefore separated by an unpowered coin flip, and Rule F is explicitly allowed to disagree with Rule M with the disagreement reported rather than resolved.
what_would_fix_it: Cut the ratio apparatus and buy power for the endpoint that answers the title. Concretely: (a) Make g(I_own, B_own) and the retention ratio R = g(I_own,B_own)/g(I0*,B_own) the sole primary, and demote A, A0 and A_all to secondary mechanism descriptors. The absorbed share is nearly redundant with E when E passes (G1 already guarantees the bank is worth >=5pt at I0*, so a null residual at I_own is itself the substitution result), and when E fails no strong claim is licensed regardless of A. Dropping A as primary deletes in one move the three-denominator problem, the mis-specification/repair channel, A_h(A0) = 0.16-0.22 sitting at its own acceptance floor, the matched-gap null, and the intersection-union overclaim Risk 25 already walks back. (b) Spend the freed compute (row 4's 4,500 episodes, row 16's 2,000, and the seeds sold from rows 6, 11 and 12) on n and seeds for rows 1, 2, 3, 6 and 19, which is what would move the +/-3pt TOST toward the +/-2pt margin the design admits it wants and would let row 19 (I_type) exclude rather than merely raise the type-label explanation at its current SE of 2.6pt. (c) Either power Rule M or demote it to a reported diagnostic alongside Rule F and Rule C; do not let an unpowered 2/3 bucket select between T1 and T4. (d) Report the acceptance floor for any surviving ratio with the sampling error of the null percentile it is read against; a 95th percentile estimated from an n = 500 single-seed row cannot be treated as a fixed threshold for an n = 1,200 endpoint. (e) Execute pre-freeze obligation (1) and read ExpeL's ablation table before submission rather than before the freeze; the novelty claim is currently conditional on searches that are all unrun.
missing_baseline: A length-matched instruction control. The grid token-matches every memory container against every other (B_own vs B_oth vs R_raw vs X_dist vs M_shuf vs C_all, all at the median per-episode injection length), but it never matches the *instruction* containers against each other. A GEPA instruction seeded from I0* and evolved over 350 rollouts is routinely several times longer than the seed scaffold, so part of the shrinkage in Inner(I_own) relative to Inner(I0*) -- which is precisely A0, a co-primary -- can be prompt mass and position rather than absorbed content: a longer instruction dilutes the relative weight of an injected block regardless of what the block says. The design needs I0* padded to I_own's token count with task-neutral prose (or I_own truncated to I0*'s length), and at minimum needs instruction token counts reported per cell as a covariate. I_type does not cover this: it is short, hand-written, and deliberately content-minimal. A secondary baseline a reviewer will also demand, given that the proposal's own nearest measurement object is Experience Distillation (2607.21051) with weights as the second container, is a LoRA fine-tune on the identical P_train episode ids as a third container; the 'no gradient access to the served model' scoping is an assumption about deployment, not a hardware constraint, and 2xA100-80GB will train LoRA on a 32B model.
preprint_collision: The check is unusually good as *process* and unusually bad as *result*, and the proposal is candid about both. Process: a dated scan (2026-09-03, prior 2026-08-21), 15 HuggingFace queries over 244 papers, by-id abstract verification for 54 IDs, a committed scan table, a self-reported correction of a web snippet that misstated ReasoningBank's Qwen gain as +7 against the PDF's +3.6, and reinstatement of five citations wrongly retracted in an earlier version. Result: novelty is not established. All five pre-freeze obligations are marked unrun, including obligation (1), the freeze-blocking search for held-out-episode/data-provenance crossovers in the contamination and data-attribution literatures -- i.e. the one search that would tell us whether the identification primitive this proposal rests on is already standard. The two most damaging precedents, AutoManual (2405.16247) and AutoGuide (2403.08978), were supplied by a reviewer rather than found by the scan, which is direct evidence the scan's recall collapses outside a six-month window, and it is exactly the pre-2026 window where 'memory as an instruction' originates. The nearest measurement collision, ExpeL's own ablation table, has never been read from source because arXiv is unreachable from the node, and the proposal states it would reduce the contribution further if that table reports a paired token-matched retention ratio. Every 2026 competitor's 'confirmed absent from the paper' claim except EvoAgentBench's rests on abstracts via a single web-snippet channel that has already produced one demonstrably wrong number. I cannot name a specific recent preprint that already runs the instruction-provenance x bank-provenance crossover, and I credit the authors for not pretending otherwise -- but an unsearched novelty claim is a weakness, and here the authors have pre-committed in writing to reducing the contribution to 'the ALFWorld measurement, the on-policy control, the item-level content check and the compiled-block comparison' if the unrun search lands. Reviewers should not be asked to accept novelty on a promissory note.
